name: Performance Magic
description: Hermetic Virtue letting a magus replace spellcasting words or gestures by performing a mundane Ability such as music or hunting.

name: Sorcerous Music
description: Performance Magic (Music); playing or singing can replace gestures and/or words of spellcasting.

name: Subtle Magic
description: Virtue interacting with Sorcerous Music that lets a caster sing without penalty for lacking gestures.

name: Quiet Magic
description: Virtue adjusting the words component of spellcasting under normal ArM5 rules.

name: Planetary Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue granting a Lab Total bonus to enchant devices by invoking a governing planet's astral influence via a Laboratory Horoscope.

name: Potent Magic
description: Minor or Major Hermetic Virtue attuning magic to a narrow field like a Magical Focus, granting +3/+6 to Lab Totals and Casting Score and allowing design of Potent spells.

name: Magical Focus
description: Virtue attuning a magus's magic to a narrow (Minor) or wide (Major) field; compatible with Potent Magic and may be astrologically defined.

name: Vulgar Alchemy
description: Minor Hermetic Mystery Virtue derived from hedge alchemy, letting a maga discover new Shape and Material Bonuses through Arcane Experimentation.

name: Withstand Casting
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue taught by the Mercurian cult that reduces Fatigue lost from spellcasting by 1 level per level of the Virtue (minimum 1).

name: Vulnerable Casting
description: Common Minor Hermetic Flaw causing the maga to lose extra Fatigue levels when casting fatiguing spells; common among Mercurian cult magi.

name: Life Boost
description: Virtue that uses the magus's life-force (lost Fatigue) to power spells.

name: Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic
description: Virtue where lost Fatigue powers spontaneous spells, making up shortfalls in casting totals.

name: Cyclic Magic
description: Virtue or Flaw giving a bonus or penalty to magic during certain cycles; may be tied to astrological cycles.

name: Astrological Cyclic Magic
description: Minor Hermetic Virtue or Flaw whose cycles follow astrological periods (male/female, cardinal/fixed/mutable, or elemental signs), with bonus of 3, 5, or 6.

name: Blatant Gift
description: Flaw imposing extra Gift penalties; example of a Mutable Blatant Gift.

name: Puissant Art
description: Virtue granting a bonus to an Art; exemplified as Mutable Puissant Terram.

name: Great Characteristic
description: Virtue increasing a Characteristic such as Great Strength; stacking limits count Mutable versions twice.

name: Hermetic Alchemy
description: Hermetic Minor Virtue letting a magus extract more vis from an aura or extract Form-specific vis, using Shape and Material Bonuses.

name: Philosophic Alchemy
description: Minor and Major Mystery Virtue building on Hermetic Alchemy; vis extraction digests on its own or produces ready-opened enchantment devices.

name: Lesser Elixir
description: Minor Mystery Virtue enhancing a Longevity Ritual with extra ingredients whose Elixir Points raise the Aging Bonus; requires Hermetic Alchemy.

name: Great Elixir
description: Major Mystery Virtue letting an alchemist create and consume a potion that transforms him into an immortal being of the Magic realm; requires Unaging and Lesser Elixir.

name: Unaging
description: Virtue sought by magi questing for eternal life; prerequisite for the Great Elixir and Initiated at the Green Kings degree.

name: Periapt
description: Minor Mystery Virtue allowing creation of astrological amulets as charged devices using a Periapt Horoscope as a single-use Lab Text.

name: Celestial Magic
description: Major Mystery Virtue replacing Planetary Magic; widens Laboratory Horoscopes, adds celestial Durations, favorable spellcasting hours and astrologically linked enchantments.

name: Ceremonial Casting
description: Mastery Ability discovered by the Cult of Mercury letting the maga apply Ceremonial Casting rules to a mastered spell.

name: Still Casting
description: Mastery Ability that removes the gestures requirement of spellcasting.

name: Fast Casting
description: Ability used to oppose a spell quickly, requiring determining the spell's Form.

name: Awareness
description: Ability used with Perception to determine the Form of a magical effect.

name: Artes Liberales
description: Academic Ability; its Astronomy specialty is key to astrological magic, Laboratory Horoscopes and Periapts.

name: Magic Theory
description: Ability limiting Potency, Shape and Material Bonuses, Elixir Level and vis handling.

name: Magic Lore
description: Ability used in Vulgar Alchemy to identify new Material and Shape Bonuses.

name: Craft
description: Crafting Ability; Craft (Mechanisms or Clocks) or Craft (Blacksmith) is used to make an armillary sphere.

name: Magic Realm
description: Realm of Power; the Great Elixir transforms a magus into a being aligned to it.

name: Creo
description: Technique used with Vim for vis extraction Lab Totals.

name: Intellego
description: Technique; Intellego Vim guidelines measure astrological time.

name: Muto
description: Technique used in Potent spells and the Great Elixir.

name: Perdo
description: Technique of destruction; pepper gives +2 Perdo.

name: Rego
description: Technique of control; magnets give bonuses to Rego effects.

name: Animal
description: Form covering beasts.

name: Aquam
description: Form of water.

name: Auram
description: Form of air.

name: Corpus
description: Form of the human body; relevant to Elixir ingredients.

name: Herbam
description: Form of plants.

name: Ignem
description: Form of fire; Rufus extracts Ignem vis.

name: Imaginem
description: Form of images; cinnamon gives +4 Imaginem.

name: Mentem
description: Form of minds.

name: Terram
description: Form of earth and metal.

name: Vim
description: Form of magic itself; used for vis extraction and astrological measurement spells.

name: Performance Duration
description: New spell Duration lasting as long as the caster performs the Performance Ability; equivalent to Concentration.

name: Laboratory Horoscope
description: Horoscope cast for a season of lab work to gain an Astrological Modifier of +1 to +5 to the Lab Total.

name: Astrological Modifier
description: Bonus (+1 to +5) to Lab Total or casting score from a successful horoscope roll.

name: Potent Spell
description: Formulaic spell designed with Casting Items whose Shape and Material Bonuses give a Potency added to Casting Score.

name: Potency
description: Score of a Potent spell equal to the sum of its Casting Item bonuses, limited by Magic Theory.

name: Casting Item
description: Physical items in a Potent spell's design that the caster must touch to cast it.

name: Shape and Material Bonuses
description: Bonuses from shapes and materials used in enchantment, Potent spells, vis extraction, and Elixirs; new alchemical entries added.

name: Mutable Virtue
description: Astrological variant of a Virtue or Flaw applying only in the mutable signs; Major becomes Minor, Minor effects doubled.

name: Mastery Ability
description: Spell Mastery abilities such as Still Casting and Ceremonial Casting.

name: Lab Text
description: Written laboratory notes allowing others to reproduce spells or enchantments.

name: Arcane Experimentation
description: ArM5 experiment rules providing an Experimentation Bonus; used by Vulgar Alchemy.

name: Enchanted Device
description: Magical item created in the lab: invested, charged, or lesser enchanted devices.

name: Verditius Runes
description: Verditius technique adding Philosophiae to Shape and Material Bonuses; incompatible with Vulgar Alchemy experimentation.

name: Fatigue
description: Exhaustion levels lost when casting spells; short-term for Formulaic, long-term for Ritual.

name: Formulaic Magic
description: Learned fixed spells; Potency applies only to Formulaic spells.

name: Ritual Magic
description: Ritual spells causing long-term Fatigue and using Ceremonial Casting.

name: Spontaneous Magic
description: Improvised spellcasting; can use Ceremonial Casting.

name: Twilight
description: Magical state that can grant or impose Virtues/Flaws; Final Twilight ends most magi.

name: Initiation
description: Mystery Cult process for gaining Virtues, possibly involving Ordeals.

name: Ordeal
description: Hardship or Flaw taken as part of Initiation, e.g. loss of a Virtue.

name: Mystagogue
description: Initiator in a Mystery Cult who teaches Virtues to Initiates.

name: Mystery Cult
description: Secret society teaching Mystery Virtues through Initiation.

name: Astrological Spell
description: Spell cast with benefit of Potent Magic or Focus in a sign, planet, or house.

name: Zodiac
description: Astrological signs classified by gender, modality (cardinal, fixed, mutable) and element.

name: Astrological House
description: One of the astrological houses, e.g. Genitor (fourth) and Valetudo (sixth).

name: Genitor
description: The fourth astrological house.

name: Valetudo
description: The sixth astrological house.

name: Planet
description: Astrological planets (Saturn, Jupiter, Mars, Venus, Mercury, Moon, Sun) governing effects and Green Cockerel degrees.

name: Vis
description: Raw magical power in pawns, extracted from auras and used in enchantment and rituals.

name: Vis Extraction
description: Lab activity extracting Vim or Form-specific vis from an aura, enhanced by Hermetic Alchemy.

name: Aura
description: Magical aura of a location, source of extracted vis and a Lab Total modifier.

name: Longevity Ritual
description: Laboratory ritual granting an Aging Bonus; base for the Lesser Elixir.

name: Aging Crisis
description: Aging event ending a Longevity Ritual's and Lesser Elixir's effectiveness.

name: Warping
description: Magical distortion; Longevity Rituals inflict Warping Points.

name: Elixir Points
description: Points from extra ingredients determining Elixir Level for the Lesser Elixir.

name: Aging Bonus
description: Bonus against aging from Longevity Ritual plus Elixir Level.

name: Magic Might
description: Might score of a Magic being, granted by the Great Elixir.

name: Immortal Magi
description: Magi transformed by the Great Elixir into immortal beings of the Magic realm.

name: Great Work
description: Alchemical goal of attaining the Elixir Vitae and eternal life, pursued by the Green Cockerel.

name: Mystery Effect
description: Enchantment outside Hermetic theory usable only as part of a Mystery ritual.

name: Great Convocation
description: Gathering of Green Cockerel Initiates held every seven years in Alexandria.

name: Fermentation Cycle
description: Competition at the Green Cockerel Great Convocation for the best breakthrough.

name: Alchemy
description: Science of refining substances and seeking transmutation and the elixir, introduced to Europe from the Arabic world.

name: Philosopher's Stone
description: Ultimate alchemical product, hatched from the Philosopher's Egg.

name: Ouroboros
description: Gnostic concept amalgamated into alchemical tradition.

name: Sulfur-Mercury Theory
description: Alchemical theory of metals present in early European alchemy.

name: Astrology
description: Study of stellar influence; a reputable science in Mythic Europe.

name: Hermetic Astrology
description: Knowledge working heavenly influences into Hermetic magic.

name: Horoscope
description: Astrological chart used for magic: Laboratory, Periapt, Nativity, Daily and spellcasting horoscopes.

name: Astrological Duration
description: Spell durations tied to heavenly movement: Minutes (Diameter), Hours, Days, Signs.

name: Favorable Hour
description: Hour identified via horoscope granting a casting bonus.

name: Astrologically Linked Enchantment
description: Enchantment linked to a target by Nativity Horoscope or to a seasonal astrological cycle.

name: Arcane Connection
description: Connection to a target that adds a Lab bonus to astrologically linked enchantments.

name: Limit of Time
description: Hermetic Limit which the armillary sphere does not break.

name: Fatalism
description: Belief that destiny is written in the stars; fashionable in the Roman Empire.

name: Divination
description: Magic of foretelling; astrology is covered under Divination and Augury.

name: Build Points
description: Points for designing covenant libraries; Potency is added to spell level.

name: Ink of Hermes
description: Alchemical ink (Hermaic Ink) made of myrrh, figs, dates, pine cones, wormwood, ibis wings; gives +3 Vim, +5 books.

name: Magical Armillary Sphere
description: Enchanted armillary sphere showing astrological conditions and translating to other times; eases Astrological Duration calculations.

name: Astrolabe
description: Planar astrolabe measuring star positions, favored in Divination (Astrology); +5 astrology bonus.

name: Alembic
description: Distilling flask with narrow neck; alchemical equipment.

name: Pelican (alchemical still)
description: Two-necked still returning distillate for re-distillation.

name: Philosopher's Egg
description: Special retort into which substances are distilled; the Philosopher's Stone hatches from it.

name: Kerotakis
description: Closed vessel exposing metal leaves to vapors; credited to Mary the Jewess.

name: Cucurbit
description: Flask with a still head attached.

name: Shiver of the Lycanthrope
description: InAn 10 Potent spell, Potency 8, silver-chased hazel wand.

name: Beast of Outlandish Size
description: MuAn 15 Potent spell, Potency 6, magnetite carved as Behemoth.

name: Cripple the Howling Wolf
description: PeAn 25 Potent spell, Potency 7, wolf bone set with magnetite.

name: Mastering the Unruly Beast
description: ReAn 25 Potent spell, Potency 7, carved wand set with magnetite.

name: Mighty Torrent of Water
description: CrAq 20 Potent spell, Potency 7, carved jade with aquamarine.

name: Enchantment of the Scrying Pool
description: InAq 30 Potent spell, Potency 7, jade inset with beryl.

name: Curse of the Desert
description: PeAq 25 Potent spell, Potency 8, jade-inlaid wand.

name: Stench of Twenty Corpses
description: CrAu 10 Potent spell, Potency 6, green turquoise and a pin feather.

name: Talons of the Wind
description: MuAu 20 Potent spell, Potency 8, fan made from ship's sail.

name: Cheating the Reaper
description: CrCo 30 Potent spell, Potency 8, disc inlaid with jasper, amber and sapphire.

name: Whispers Through the Black Gate
description: InCo 15 Potent spell, Potency 9, green turquoise and star ruby.

name: Curse of Circe
description: MuCo(An) 30 Potent spell, Potency 7, pig skin.

name: Grip of the Choking Hand
description: PeCo 25 Potent spell, Potency 10, human-bone wand bound with cord.

name: Rise of the Feathery Body
description: ReCo 10 Potent spell, Potency 8, glove with a magnet sewn in.

name: Ward Against Faeries of the Wood
description: ReHe 25 (gen.) Potent spell, Potency 9, iron horseshoe.

name: Pilum of Fire
description: CrIg 20 spell; Potent version Potency 11 needs miniature lamp, hearth and wand; also enchanted into Notara's wand.

name: Trapping the Fire
description: MuIg 25 Potent spell, Potency 9, fired clay bound in a net.

name: Wizard's Icy Grip
description: PeIg 30 Potent spell, Potency 7, wand with rock crystal sphere.

name: Haunt of the Living Ghost
description: CrIm(In) 35 Potent spell, Potency 8, rock crystal sphere on hazel wand.

name: Summoning the Distant Image
description: InIm 25 Potent spell, Potency 8, rock crystal sphere on hazel wand.

name: The Captive Voice
description: ReIm 30 Potent spell, Potency 7, mask and necklace.

name: Weight of a Thousand Hells
description: CrMe 25 Potent spell, Potency 9, dagger with amethyst and frankincense.

name: Posing the Silent Question
description: InMe 20 Potent spell, Potency 5, silver-chased hazel wand.

name: Vision of the Haunting Spirits
description: MuMe(Im) 40 Potent spell, Potency 8, green turquoise and cinnamon.

name: Confusion of the Numbed Will
description: ReMe 15 Potent spell, Potency 7, magnet carved as a human skull.

name: The Crystal Dart
description: MuTe(Re) 10 Potent spell, Potency 6, dagger and spade.

name: Ward Against Faeries of the Mountain
description: ReTe 15 Potent spell, Potency 9, iron horseshoe.

name: The Enigma's Gift
description: CrVi 30 Potent spell, Potency 4, parchment inscribed with Ink of Hermes.

name: Sight of the Active Magics
description: InVi 40 Potent spell, Potency 6, hazel wand stained with Ink of Hermes.

name: Demon's Eternal Oblivion
description: PeVi 30 (gen.) Potent spell, Potency 12, red coral and frankincense.

name: Disguise of the Putrid Aroma
description: Spell used as an example of a Potent version with a wand and magnetite.

name: Tracks of the Faerie Glow
description: Spell of which Hunter's Tracks of the Faerie Glow is a Performance variant.

name: Hunter's Tracks of the Faerie Glow
description: Performance Duration variant of Tracks of the Faerie Glow, lasting while the caster hunts.

name: Sung Lamp Without Flame
description: Performance Duration light spell lasting while the caster sings.

name: Maintaining the Demanding Spell
description: Effect used in an enchanted device to maintain a concentration spell.

name: Aura of Rightful Authority
description: Rulership effect governed by the sun, used in an enchanting example.

name: Ward Against Heat and Flames
description: Effect posited to extract Ignem vis via Hermetic Alchemy.

name: Divide the Gathered Essence
description: ReVi 25 spell transferring raw vis from an item into one or more containers.

name: Become a Being of Magic
description: MuCo(Vi) 50 Mystery Effect of the Great Elixir transforming the magus into a magical creature.

name: Grant Might
description: CrVi Mystery Effect of the Great Elixir granting Magic Might equal to half (level-20).

name: Sense the Hour
description: InVi 10 spell measuring astrological time around the magus.

name: Sight of the Astrological Hour
description: InVi 20 spell measuring astrological time at a visible point.

name: Divine Heaven's Aspect
description: InVi 30 spell reporting all astrological conditions at a visible or Arcane-connected point.

name: Know the Heavens
description: Effect linked in a magical armillary sphere to report astrological conditions.

name: Duplicate the Mechanism
description: Cr(In)Te 35 Ritual creating an exact duplicate of an existing mechanism.

name: Duplicate the Noble Mechanism
description: Level 45 ritual variant creating a precious-metal mechanism.

name: Craft the Mechanism
description: Spell creating a new mechanism without Intellego requisite.

name: Jahm of Alexandria
description: Ex Miscellanea magus who rediscovered Hermetic Alchemy in the tenth century (956 AD), origin of the Green Cockerel.

name: Pseudo-Democritus
description: Author of the earliest known Greek alchemical text, Physika kai Mystika.

name: Synesius
description: Stated that Pseudo-Democritus' work was in four books.

name: Mary the Jewess
description: Early alchemist credited with inventing an efficient still, the water bath and the kerotakis.

name: Bolos of Mendes
description: Probable ultimate origin of Pseudo-Democritus' tradition, two centuries before Christ.

name: Zosimos
description: Late third-century alchemist whose Visions identify the alchemical process with Christ.

name: Jabir Ibn Hayyan
description: Arabic alchemist who stressed mercury and the four qualities.

name: Rhases
description: Physician who wrote on alchemical theory and the elixir.

name: Avicenna
description: Author of De Congelatione, denying real transmutation.

name: Albertus Magnus
description: Scholar influenced by Avicenna on alchemy.

name: Vincent of Beauvais
description: 13th-century encyclopedist discussing alchemy.

name: Ramon Lull
description: Scholar discussing alchemy.

name: Morienus Romanus
description: Author of Liber de Compositione Alchemiae.

name: Robert of Chester
description: Translated Liber de Compositione Alchemiae into Latin in 1144.

name: Gerard of Cremona
description: Translated De Aluminibus et Salibus.

name: Thomas Aquinas
description: Discussed alchemy in his works.

name: Roger Bacon
description: Discussed alchemy in his encyclopedic works.

name: Jesus Christ
description: Identified with the alchemical process in the Visions of Zosimos.

name: St. Augustine
description: Church father who attacked astrology in City of God.

name: Abu Ma'shar
description: Author of the Greater Introduction to Astrology.

name: Ptolemy
description: Author of the Tetrabiblos; the Centiloquium is falsely ascribed to him.

name: Firmicus Maternus
description: Writer on astrology whose works are used extensively.

name: Frederick II
description: Ruler who had his children's horoscopes cast.

name: Michael Scot
description: Gave astrological advice to Frederick II.

name: Thabit ibn Qurra
description: Arabic writer (836-901) of a formula to rid a place of scorpions.

name: Alfonso the Wise
description: King under whom the Picatrix was translated.

name: Eratosthenes
description: Devised the armillary sphere in antiquity.

name: Bonisagus
description: Founder whose breakthroughs let Hermetic magic ignore astral influences.

name: Secret Master
description: Sole Green Cockerel Initiate to have completed the Great Work, never seen by members; gender disputed.

name: Orlando
description: Example magus and musician who knows Sorcerous Music and Subtle Magic.

name: Furioso
description: Example Sorcerous Musician lacking Subtle Magic.

name: Harold
description: Example magus with Performance Magic (Hunt).

name: Astra
description: Example maga using Laboratory Horoscopes.

name: Julius
description: Example magus demonstrating Vulgar Alchemy experimentation.

name: Vita
description: Example maga with Life-Linked Spontaneous Magic.

name: Stellus
description: Example Initiate born under Capricorn.

name: Astera
description: Mystagogue of Stellus, born under Sagittarius.

name: Stella
description: Example maga with astrological Cyclic Magic.

name: Raucus
description: Example magus with Mutable Blatant Gift.

name: Effica
description: Example maga with Mutable Puissant Terram.

name: Rufus
description: Example magus extracting vis with Hermetic Alchemy.

name: Parella
description: Example maga using Major Philosophic Alchemy.

name: Desperata
description: Example alchemist maga who achieves the Great Elixir aged 161.

name: Erratus
description: Example magus who miscalculates an Astrological Duration.

name: Notara
description: Example maga making astrologically linked enchantments, including a Pilum of Fire wand.

name: Order of the Green Cockerel
description: Secret Hermetic Mystery Cult of alchemists pursuing the Great Work (Elixir Vitae), in secret contact with Islamic wizards; has seven degrees.

name: Toads
description: First Green Cockerel degree: calcination, Saturn, black, lead; learns Planetary Magic.

name: White Swans
description: Second degree: dissolution, Jupiter, grayish-white, tin; learns Vulgar Alchemy.

name: Green Kings
description: Third degree: separation, Mars, green, iron; Initiated into Unaging before exile.

name: Peacocks
description: Fourth degree: conjunction, Venus, copper; learns Hermetic Alchemy.

name: Unicorns
description: Fifth degree: fermentation, Mercury, white; ambassadors who learn the Lesser Elixir.

name: Pelicans
description: Sixth degree: distillation, Moon, silver, red; Mystagogues who learn Philosophic Alchemy.

name: Phoenix
description: Seventh degree: coagulation, Sun, gold; learns the Great Elixir from the Secret Master.

name: Cult of Mercury
description: Mercurian Mystery Cult teaching Withstand Casting and Ceremonial Casting; its magi often have Vulnerable Casting.

name: Order of Hermes
description: The Hermetic Order of magi.

name: Chaldeans
description: The most famous astrologers of the past.

name: Ex Miscellanea
description: Hermetic House to which Jahm of Alexandria belonged.

name: House Verditius
description: House of craftsman magi who use Verditius Runes and Craft in enchanting.

name: Novgorod Tribunal
description: Tribunal where mundane alchemy is still rare.

name: Hibernian Tribunal
description: Tribunal where mundane alchemy is still rare.

name: Loch Leglean Tribunal
description: Tribunal where mundane alchemy is still rare.

name: Alexandria
description: City where the Green Cockerel's Great Convocation is held every seven years.

name: Levant
description: Region frequently visited by Green Cockerel members.

name: North Africa
description: Region frequently visited by Green Cockerel members.

name: Granada
description: Region frequently visited by Green Cockerel members.

name: Mythic Europe
description: The Ars Magica setting.

name: Roman Empire
description: Where astrological fatalism grew fashionable.

name: Behemoth
description: Great beast whose carved shape gives +3 great size.

name: Lycanthrope
description: Werewolf; silver gives +5 against lycanthropes.

name: Faerie
description: Beings warded by Ward Against Faeries spells using iron horseshoes.

name: Demon
description: Infernal spirits; red coral +10 vs demons, cinquefoil drives them away.

name: Physika kai Mystika
description: Earliest Greek alchemical text, by Pseudo-Democritus.

name: Gold-Making of Cleopatra
description: Gnostic alchemical text.

name: Visions of Zosimos
description: Late third-century alchemical text.

name: Turba Philosophorum
description: Translation of an Arabic alchemical work using the marriage simile.

name: De Congelatione
description: Avicenna's work denying real transmutation.

name: De Anima in Arte Alchimiae
description: Work attributed to Avicenna supporting transmutation.

name: Liber de Compositione Alchemiae
description: First Arabic alchemical work translated into Latin (1144).

name: De Aluminibus et Salibus
description: Alchemical work attributed to Rhases.

name: City of God
description: St. Augustine's work attacking astrology.

name: Greater Introduction to Astrology
description: Abu Ma'shar's work, translated in 1133.

name: Tetrabiblos
description: Ptolemy's astrology text, translated 1138.

name: Centiloquium
description: Aphorisms falsely ascribed to Ptolemy.

name: Picatrix
description: Best known work of astral magic, translated under Alfonso the Wise.
